item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nreport=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json'))\\nassert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]\\nprobes=[\\n({'from':'draft','to':'ready'}, {'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),\\n({'from':'none','to':'ready','role':'operator_0','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),\\n({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),\\n({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'operator_0','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'running','reason':'ok'}),\\n({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),\\n({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':False}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':False,'attempts':99}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'})\\n]\\nfor request, expected in probes:\\n    request_before=copy.deepcopy(request); policy_before=copy.deepcopy(policy)\\n    assert evaluate(request, policy)==expected\\n    assert request==request_before and policy==policy_before\\nprint(json.dumps({'fixture_count':len(requests),'probe_count':len(probes),'all_passed':True,'inputs_unchanged':True}))\"]}"}
